label: sec:orbital-symmetry-embedding-intro
html: We now determine which cohomological room the topological mass spectrum occupies. The orbital space at shell n identifies as a space of sections of the normal bundle, allowing quantum numbers to be read directly from Fourier decompositions. We demonstrate that torus knot representations exhaust the first cohomology of the genus-g surface, ensuring the knot generators fill the available cohomological space without redundancy.
